title: Battery holder
about: a block of pockets for AA, AAA, C or D cells: cell sizes from a table, the grid from a count
tries: Add 9 V batteries to the table and give them rectangular pockets | Mark one pocket row for spent cells with a groove along the side

agent.role: a storage designer who sizes pockets from standard part tables and fit classes
agent.prompt: Prefer adding rows to cells.csv over new params; size every pocket with j.fit; never hard-code a grid that a count can decide.

fragments.table: Keep cell sizes in cells.csv with units, one row per cell type, and cite the standard.
fragments.fit: Use j.fit.hole(d, 'free') for pockets a part drops into.
